title: piece of junk
text:
piece of junk. My husband said it was his old humidifier. He said it worked fine before, but when we tried it a week ago it leaked all the water onto the floor, which subsequently flowed under our bed (and we discovered our room has a slight angle to it!).

Today I tried figuring out why it leaked, but I can't even get the water basin to close. The piece that is supposed to lock into place simply will not do it if the rubber ring/washer thing is in there, which you need in order for it NOT to leak. I tried pushing on it so it would sit in the opening enough to turn it to the lock position but it's like the rubber ring is too thick for it to do that. So much for that.

product_metadata.title: Reli on Humidifier
description: Packaged in a box in good condition with some wear on the corners. Instructions inside Unit very clean tested and ready to use. Some light wear on 1 side of top plastic piece that holds water
